last.verdict: Shopify kept revenue growing 32% while profit rose much faster, but gross profit is growing slower than sales.

takeaways.label: Profit outpacing sales
takeaways.text: Operating income jumped 66% to $568 million and free cash flow margin reached 22%, up from 18%, as costs grew slower than revenue.

takeaways.label: Growth steady, not accelerating
takeaways.text: Revenue grew 32%, in line with the low-thirties outlook, after 34% last quarter. Fourth-quarter revenue is guided to grow at a low-thirties rate again.

takeaways.label: Gross profit lags revenue
takeaways.text: Gross profit grew 28% versus 32% for revenue, and fourth-quarter gross profit is guided to a high-twenties rate. Revenue is shifting toward lower-margin payments.

takeaways.label: Big buyback
takeaways.text: Shopify repurchased $562 million of its own stock in the quarter, after none a year earlier, while still ending with about $4.7 billion in cash and securities.

history.verdict: Growth sped up and the outlook stayed strong, so a beaten-down stock jumped.

reasons.label: Growth speeding up
reasons.text: Revenue rose 34%, ahead of the high-twenties growth Shopify had guided for this quarter.

reasons.label: Strong profit and cash
reasons.text: Free cash flow margin reached 18%, up from 16%, and operating income rose 68%.

reasons.label: Confident next-quarter outlook
reasons.text: Shopify guided Q3 revenue growth to the low thirties and free cash flow margin to the high-teens to low-twenties.
